title: Reasoning Beyond Labels: Measuring LLM Sentiment in Low-Resource, Culturally Nuanced Contexts
reasoning: The paper explicitly incorporates religious expression and faith-based communication as key variables in its diagnostic framework for evaluating LLM sentiment analysis. It categorizes religious cues (e.g., appeals to divine foresight) as a cultural complexity and uses them to benchmark model interpretability and alignment with human reasoning in the context of Kenyan youth chat groups.
